title: Faults
moduleInfo: Every truck's fault state and a log of its fault events. Fleet asks each truck's eData module for its active fault codes every 30 minutes and checks the stored reports every 15 minutes; the page refreshes every minute. “No active codes” holds only while the truck sends CAN data.
